question: Two beams of light, one Blue and one Red, are incident on the same photosensitive surface. If the Blue light has a higher frequency than the Red light, which of the following statements correctly describes their stopping potentials?

options.A: Red light requires a more negative stopping potential
options.B: Blue light requires a more negative stopping potential
options.C: Both require the same stopping potential
options.D: Stopping potential depends only on brightness, not color
